reason: I'd probably play with the free tricks, but typing my card into some random website to unlock a 'browser-installed' app feels sketchy. I buy small apps on impulse through the App Store or Google Play where I know I can get a refund, not from a site I've never heard of.
objection: It's a website, not a real app from the App Store. How do I know they won't just take my card details, or that the 'Photos gallery' and 'incoming call' tricks actually work on my phone and aren't a cheap fake?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a Hebrew TikTok or Reel of a real person pulling off the gallery or incoming-call trick on a friend, plus a known payment option like Apple Pay, Google Pay or Bit with a clear refund policy.
